a.lede: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]
a.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks

b.lede: Rapidly advancing AI models are making it cheaper and easier to uncover critical vulnerabilities, but it’s a double-edged sword – and a gift to hackers.
b.title: AI finds zero-day flaws for just $4 now – even mediocre hackers can cash in
